title: Prostate ultrasound
what: An ultrasound check of the prostate gland. Most often the probe is placed in the rectum. This gives the best view of the prostate. Sometimes it is checked through the belly.
why: For frequent or difficult peeing, pain between the legs, a high PSA, infertility, or to keep watch on the prostate.
tell_doctor: If you have hemorrhoids or fissures, or recently had surgery on the rectum
If you are allergic to latex. The probe is covered with a protective sleeve

prepare.title: Bowel
prepare.text: Usually a small cleansing enema is done the evening before, or 1 to 2 hours before in the morning. Your clinic will tell you how.

prepare.title: Bladder
prepare.text: You are often asked to come with a fairly full bladder: drink about 1 liter of water over an hour and do not pee. Check with your clinic.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You can eat. The day before, it is best to avoid foods that cause gas: cabbage, beans, and fizzy drinks.

bring: Your PSA result, if you had the test
steps: You undress below the waist and lie on your left side with your knees to your chest
If your belly is checked too, the probe is first moved over your belly with gel
The doctor puts a cover on the thin probe and coats it with gel
The probe is gently put a few centimeters into the rectum
Sometimes you are asked to pee, and the doctor checks how much urine is left in the bladder
feel: Pressure and an urge to go to the toilet. This is normal and passes quickly
It should not hurt. If it is uncomfortable, tell the doctor, and they will be more gentle
after: You can go back to your day right away
You usually get the report right away
Talk about the result with your urologist

faq.a: Usually not. The probe is thin and well coated with gel. You feel pressure, but not pain.

faq.q: Why use a probe in the rectum when there is a belly ultrasound?
faq.a: The prostate sits right behind the bowel wall. This way the doctor sees it closer and more clearly than through the belly and bladder.

reminders.text: Prostate ultrasound tomorrow. Check when and how to do the small cleansing enema, as your clinic advised.
